mentions.sentence: Costello syndrome (CS) is a RASopathy caused by activating germline mutations in HRAS.

candidates.label: Protein serine/threonine kinase activity
candidates.summary: Catalysis of the reactions: ATP + protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate, and ATP + protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate.

candidates.label: Negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction
candidates.summary: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of Ras protein signal transduction.

candidates.label: Positive regulation of Ras protein signal transduction
candidates.summary: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of Ras protein signal transduction.

candidates.label: Ras protein signal transduction
candidates.summary: An intracellular signaling cassette in which a small monomeric GTPase of the Ras subfamily relays a signal.

candidates.label: Protein destabilization / misfolding
candidates.summary: The variant protein is made but is unstable or misfolds, so it is degraded, aggregates, or is retained inside the cell instead of reaching its working location.

candidates.label: Synaptic vesicle fusion with the active zone membrane
candidates.summary: Fusion of the membrane of a synaptic vesicle with the presynaptic active zone membrane, thereby releasing its cargo neurotransmitters into the synaptic cleft.

candidates.label: Gain of function (the protein does too much)
candidates.summary: The variant protein is overactive: in these disorders that usually means synaptic vesicles fuse too readily, or neurotransmitter is released when it should not

candidates.label: HRAS-related disorders (Costello syndrome)
synonyms: congenital myopathy with excess of muscle spindles
candidates.summary: Germline activating HRAS changes cause Costello syndrome: feeding problems, loose skin, heart disease, developmental delay and a raised tumour risk.

candidates.label: ARSA-related disorders (metachromatic leukodystrophy)
candidates.summary: Deficiency of arylsulfatase A makes sulfatides build up and destroys myelin in the brain and nerves, causing loss of motor and cognitive skills.

candidates.label: BRAF-related RASopathies (cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome)
synonyms: cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome caused by mutation in BRAF
candidates.summary: Germline BRAF changes mostly cause cardiofaciocutaneous (CFC) syndrome: heart defects, skin and hair changes and developmental delay; some cause Noonan syndrome

candidates.label: CACNA1A-related disorders
candidates.summary: Gene-defined umbrella for conditions caused by variants in CACNA1A (8 curated clinical entities in OMIM/Orphanet).

candidates.label: CBL-related disorder

Noonan syndrome-like disorder with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia
candidates.summary: Germline CBL changes cause a Noonan syndrome-like disorder with a predisposition to juvenile myelomonocytic leukaemia.

candidates.label: CDKL5 deficiency disorder

early infantile epileptic encephalopathy caused by mutation in CDKL5
candidates.summary: Gene-defined umbrella for conditions caused by variants in CDKL5 (4 curated clinical entities in OMIM/Orphanet).
